hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Body seals
function: The seals between the inner sleeve and the housing above and below the ports that hold pressure until the sleeve shifts.

tabs.overview: Elastomer o-rings with backups in grooves on the sleeve; rated for the fluids and temperature.
tabs.engineering: Elastomer for the fluid and temperature.
tabs.safety: A seal leak shows as a stage that will not build pressure.
tabs.evidence: Completion codes article (S34), ball injector patent (S35), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
